post.caption:
In April 2011, Catherine Middleton's family received a new coat of arms with three acorns, one for each Middleton child, because oak trees grow around the family's home in West Berkshire. Her parents gave her wedding earrings made by the London jeweler Robinson Pelham. Each earring has diamond oak leaves and a pear shaped diamond drop, with a small diamond acorn hanging in the center, and the design draws on the new coat of arms. She wore them on her wedding day, April 29, 2011, and again at the Easter service in 2019.
